needed.evidence: Footway is narrow (<1m) with potential informal use and partially blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Construct a physical barrier or widen the existing footway to a minimum of 3 meters width from the edge of the driving lane on the left side.

needed.evidence: Partially blocked footway due to obstructions
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions to ensure a clear, continuous, and fully usable footway on the left side.

needed.evidence: Uneven or broken sections on the footway
needed.suggestion: Repair the footway on the left side to eliminate trip hazards, ensuring smooth and even walking surfaces.

needed.evidence: No proper crossing facility in the view despite high crossing demand
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised crossing with a refuge island midway across to improve safety for pedestrians crossing the busy road.

needed.evidence: Current marked crossing is obstructed and hard to see for drivers
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the crossing to a signalised crossing with enhanced visibility features such as raised platforms and clear markings to ensure drivers notice and stop for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Wide road with no refuge for pedestrians midway at the marked crossing
needed.suggestion: Introduce a refuge island at the midpoint of this crossing to provide a safer place for pedestrians to wait when crossing the multi-lane road.

needed.evidence: Only one kerb ramp present at crossing, missing on the opposite kerb
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps on both sides of the crossing to ensure accessibility and compliance with pedestrian crossing infrastructure standards.
